title: How Far Recall Coverage Runs in the TRICARE Retired Reserve Recall Month Relief
content:
**Training questions - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Retired Reserve.**

**Rule.** Active duty days count toward the recall month relief only as far as that coverage runs: where the active duty enrollment shows its coverage running more than 30 days from its effective date, the relief counts through the last day of the month; where it shows its coverage running 30 days or fewer, the relief counts only through the last day that coverage runs; otherwise no day counts.

**What is the active duty enrollment, and how is its length read?** The purchaser's applied or active TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment; its length is the number of days from its effective date to the coverage end date (disenrollment date) its record shows.

**What is "the last day that coverage runs"?** That coverage end date, and never later than the last day of the month.

**What falls under "otherwise"?** No applied or active enrollment, or one whose record shows no coverage end date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, latest-billed month June, effective date 11 June)

| Coverage end shown | Length | Relief counts through |
|---|---|---|
| 12 July | 31 days | 30 June, the last day of the month |
| 11 July | 30 days | 30 June, as the coverage runs past the month's end |
| 20 June | 9 days | 20 June |
| none | - | no day counts |
